Paired branch for the default-workspace-template's chat-agent-split, phases 1 and 2 together (`docs/system/blueprint/chat-agent-split/plan-chat-agent-split.md` there). Phase 1: every in-workspace sender messages a chat through the chat app by chat id, with `mngr message` as the backoff. Phase 2: the template names a chat apart from the agent it runs on. No code in this repository changes; the branch exists so the template change runs this repository's test suites too.
